destinations.name: Discord
destinations.statedText: For non-Nitro subscribers, the maximum file upload is 20MB.
destinations.note: Raised from 10MB in August 2026 per the same page. Discord checks size before compression.

destinations.name: Discord Nitro Basic
destinations.statedText: If you need more room regularly, Nitro Basic offers 50MB and Nitro offers up to 1GB.

destinations.name: Gmail
destinations.statedText: For personal Gmail accounts, the limit is 25 MB.
destinations.note: This is the provider's stated cap. Email attachments are base64-encoded when sent, which adds about a third to their size, so recommendedBytes is 72% of the cap. The provider's page does not mention encoding; the 72% figure is our own conservative allowance, not a provider number.

destinations.name: Yahoo Mail
destinations.statedText: The sum of all attached files in a single message, both for incoming and outgoing email, must not exceed 25MB in total file size.
destinations.note: This is the provider's stated cap. Email attachments are base64-encoded when sent, which adds about a third to their size, so recommendedBytes is 72% of the cap. The provider's page does not mention encoding; the 72% figure is our own conservative allowance, not a provider number.

destinations.name: iCloud Mail
destinations.statedText: The size of incoming and outgoing messages (20MB, up to 5GB with Mail Drop turned on)
destinations.note: This is the provider's stated cap. Email attachments are base64-encoded when sent, which adds about a third to their size, so recommendedBytes is 72% of the cap. The provider's page does not mention encoding; the 72% figure is our own conservative allowance, not a provider number.

destinations.name: WhatsApp
destinations.statedText: For documents, the maximum file size allowed is 2 GB.
destinations.note: Applies only when the file is attached as a document. Videos sent as media have a different, connection-dependent limit that is not included here.

destinations.name: GitHub
destinations.statedText: The maximum file size is: 10MB for images and gifs; 10MB for videos uploaded to a repository owned by a user or organization on a free GitHub plan
destinations.note: Issue, pull request and comment attachments. Videos in repositories on a paid plan are allowed 100MB.

destinations.name: GitHub
destinations.statedText: The maximum file size is: 25MB for all other files
destinations.note: Issue, pull request and comment attachments.

destinations.name: LinkedIn
destinations.statedText: The file size cannot exceed 100 MB.
destinations.note: The page lists this under a general note for supported media files; applied here to documents only.

destinations.name: Slack
destinations.statedText: Members and guests can add files up to 1GB in size.

destinations.name: Telegram
destinations.statedText: Send and receive files of any type, up to 2 GB in size each (or 4 GB with Premium), access them instantly on your other devices.
